data.description:
The other half of v1's definition of done, and the task that declares v1 complete. One recorded manual run of the full loop against REAL STRIPE TEST MODE, through the real UI, on the local compose stack: hosted Connect onboarding round trip, invoice finalize and send, Stripe's own email arriving for the client, payment on Stripe's hosted page with a test card, real webhook delivery, and paid status appearing in the app. Record what happened, including every divergence from the fake.

IMPLEMENTS: docs/engineering/00-d1-v1-milestone-plan.md section 3 row C-06 (IN by mandate — v1 definition of done, section 6.1).

DECISION CONTEXT. This is a separate task precisely because it needs an external account, and the right-sizing rules (milestone plan section 8.2) forbid a task that would need a board ask mid-flight — the ask gets split out and sequenced ahead of it. It is gated on two board asks, both already filed: the free Stripe test-mode account, and the board's confirmation of what "v1 done" means. It settles the four things the D1 spike listed as unmeasured: webhook delivery fidelity and ordering; real onboarding through account_links (including whether test mode accepts http://localhost return URLs); Stripe's invoice email actually arriving; and real invoice state transitions.

If localhost return/refresh URLs turn out to be rejected, FILE A NEW BOARD ASK for local ingress — do not open a tunnel, a proxy, or any other account. Every processor, ESP, or carrier signup is board-gated regardless of price (CLAUDE.md, Product), and that rule does not weaken because a task is inconvenient to finish.

VERIFICATION: a written run record committed under docs/engineering/ with the observed sequence, the test-mode Stripe ids involved, a transcript or screenshots of each step, and a list of every divergence from the stateful double used in the automated suite — each divergence either fixed in the same tick or filed as its own task.

NOT IN THIS TASK: live mode or real money (row C-45, OUT — Rule 3, entity-gated); deployment anywhere (row C-46, OUT — Rule 3); opening any account, which is the board's action on the ask, not ours.

data.body: Planner note from the AS-49 review (Priya, 2026-09-12), folded here per the triage gate — no behaviour defect, no task: (R3) E5's subset check compares the double's top-level keys + status_transitions against stripe-mock's fixtures; nested requirements.* / metadata are unchecked, so the acceptance run is where nested fidelity gets seen. (R4) a webhook event that lands as 'conflict' (e.g. void after paid) is recorded, so its redelivery answers 'duplicate' — by AS-44 design; worth a runbook line in the acceptance record. (Q5 from the AS-49 plan) E1's committed call order and the double's event sequence are the natural 'expected' column for the recorded run.

Plan at .lattice/plans/task_01M1D34PDBBXVAKM7DDED3VG8M.md (61 lines). Implementer developer-marcus, reviewer qa-priya (Ruben if she is mid-cycle). Branch feat/AS-50-stripe-acceptance-run, worktree .worktrees/AS-50.

Shape: a host-side, zero-dependency, resumable driver (apps/invoicing/acceptance/run.mjs) does everything a tick can do; the board acts exactly twice, both at a browser on Stripe's hosted pages. Phase 1 (Marcus's implementation tick, run for real): relay on 127.0.0.1:8352 that forwards raw bytes to /webhooks/stripe and logs every delivery with its outcome; stripe listen detached under the board's own account with --forward-connect-to; web up with both secrets via child env (boot line must show both [redacted]); throwaway freelancer signed up. Gate A (needs_human): board signs in, presses Connect Stripe, completes test-mode onboarding, replies "done" plus the client email to use. Phase 2: readiness by push and pull, then client, contract, draft, finalize, send in E1's order; in-window replay (duplicate) and tamper (400) probes fire on the first invoice delivery. Gate B (needs_human): board checks the inbox, pays on the hosted page with 4242, replies. Phase 3: paid via webhook, tolerance probe (> 300 s replay -> 400), custody reads through the CLI's read-only verbs (invoice invisible at platform scope; platform balance transactions 0), mechanical divergence list vs the double's fixtures, record written by the redactor only.

Decisions: no board ask up front. stripe listen under the same account was in ask A1 and the board satisfied it; 127.0.0.1 return URLs are within Stripe's documented test-mode rule and the board's browser is on the host. If Stripe refuses the return URL, the pre-committed step is a filed ingress ask and AS-50 -> blocked; no tunnel. Secrets: never printed, never written; the state file keeps only a hash of the signing secret; the redactor throws on any key prefix and masks emails and hosted-invoice tokens. The record is docs/engineering/06-d1-v1-acceptance-run.md plus a directory of driver-written artifacts. Teardown at merge is down -v.

Open, time-boxed with defaults (plan §7): STRIPE_API_KEY env vs --api-key; Ready-line secret vs --print-secret; whether test mode emails at all (both branches pre-committed; a "no" is a recorded divergence and payment proceeds from the screen-5 URL); screenshots not required.

What the board must do: nothing yet. Gate A arrives after Marcus's phase 1 lands.

Phase 1 ran for real and STOPPED at the driver-side Connect start: POST /connect-stripe/start answered 502 (screen 2 S2-ERROR-SYSTEM, no account row). Replayed from the host with the same key and Stripe-Version: the bare POST /v1/accounts that onboarding.js makes is refused by Stripe, 400 invalid_request_error "Stripe no longer recommends Accounts v1 for new Connect integrations ... enable Accounts v1 support in the Dashboard: dashboard.stripe.com/settings/features/feat_accounts_v1_support" (req_lEJA1UlCpOyy8b). The key works (GET /v1/account 200, acct_1UEt5BE6PyFsj8A8). NOT the plan-§1 return_url contingency (that fails at /v1/account_links after an account exists) and not transport. Filed AS-134 (board ask: the free Dashboard toggle, same account, no signup; or Owen chooses an Accounts v2 migration as its own task), linked AS-50 depends_on AS-134. Recommend AS-50 -> blocked on AS-134; no tunnel, no proxy, no new account, no code change to onboarding.js.

Observed before the stop, all real: relay up 127.0.0.1:8352 (pid 44358); stripe listen Ready under the same account, API version 2026-08-26.dahlia, STRIPE_API_KEY honoured from the env (Q1: yes; Q2: secret parsed from the Ready line; listen.log redacted at write time); web up via compose --build with both secrets, boot line and /healthz show [redacted] for both (AC-1 precondition held); signup 303 -> /, GET / 200 S3-EMPTY-FIRSTRUN. Listener pid 44584 (wrapper 44583) and relay 44358 left alive; web left up; state in apps/invoicing/acceptance/state/ (helpers.json, listen.log, contingency.json; run.json NOT written — the stop precedes it). .env.local is read from the main checkout (a worktree lacks the gitignored file), never copied.

Branch feat/AS-50-stripe-acceptance-run: 2f612aa driver/relay/redactor + AC-12 changes; 663915a phase-1 fixes and a guard hardening — the demo-import regex `(from|import\s*\()` let a bare `import '…/'` through; now `(from|import)\s*\(?` (a survivor I measured, not a plan item). Suite under --build: `Image asc-invoicing-test Built`, 524 tests / 505 pass / 0 fail / 19 skipped (green2). Reds: AC-10 CliRefusal on `invoices pay`, no spawn; AC-11 RedactionError on `whsec_x`, emails -> [client-email]/[freelancer-email], hosted URL -> …/[token]; AC-12 mutant `import '../acceptance/../routes/health.js'` in routes/pages.js -> 524/504/1 at the guard's own assertion naming routes/pages.js (mutant4; mutant1 with a non-resolving path went red for ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND in 20 files instead). Phases 2 and 3 are implemented but unexercised. Receipts and probe output: scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-50/ (suite-*.log, reds-ac10-ac11.txt, phase1 notes, gate-a.md, diag-accounts.mjs).

in_progress -> blocked on AS-134 (Stripe refuses the bare POST /v1/accounts until 'Accounts v1 support' is enabled on the account — a real divergence the double could not show; not the plan's return_url contingency). Driver committed on the branch (2f612aa, 663915a); phase 1 observed for real up to connect start (listen Ready, relay 8352, boot line + /healthz redacted, signup 303, dashboard 200). Listener pid 44584 and relay pid 44358 left running with asc-invoicing-web-1 on 8348 so the re-run of 'up' after the toggle resumes idempotently. Compose receipt: Image asc-invoicing-test Built 524/505/0/19; reds AC-10, AC-11, AC-12 observed (scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-50/). One unplanned guard hardening (side-effect import form in the demo-import regex) rides on the branch — Priya should treat it as a finding to verify, not a given. Resumes when AS-134 clears.
